title: A coordinate-ring elliptic sequence with the torsion zero sets
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass equation over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. Let A=k[X,Y]/(W(X,Y)), let q:k[X,Y]→A be the quotient map, let h=q(W.ψ₂), and let I_(x,y) be the ideal of A generated by the classes of X−x and Y−y. There exists f:ℕ→A with f₀=0, f₁=1, f₂=h, f₃=q(C(W.Ψ₃)), f₄=h q(C(W.preΨ₄)); for every r≥2, f_(2r+1)=f_(r+2)f_r³−f_(r−1)f_(r+1)³; for every r≥3, h f_(2r)=f_r(f_(r+2)f_(r−1)²−f_(r−2)f_(r+1)²); and for every n>0 and every nonsingular affine point P=(x,y), f_n∈I_(x,y) if and only if nP=O. Here C includes a univariate polynomial in k[X] into k[X,Y], and O denotes the identity in W.toAffine.Point.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → let q := WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk W.toAffine; let h := q W.ψ₂; ∃ f : ℕ → W.toAffine.CoordinateRing, (f 0 = 0 ∧ f 1 = 1 ∧ f 2 = h ∧ f 3 = q (Polynomial.C W.Ψ₃) ∧ f 4 = h * q (Polynomial.C W.preΨ₄) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 2 ≤ r → f (2 * r + 1) = f (r + 2) * f r ^ 3 - f (r - 1) * f (r + 1) ^ 3) ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, 3 ≤ r → h * f (2 * r) = f r * (f (r + 2) * f (r - 1) ^ 2 - f (r - 2) * f (r + 1) ^ 2))) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∀ (x y : k) (hP : W.toAffine.Nonsingular x y), f n ∈ WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.XYIdeal W.toAffine x (Polynomial.C y) ↔ n • WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.some x y hP = 0
